link.title: Managing Scripts Within Bitbybit Cloud Projects
link.description: Scripts are the programs inside a project, each written in Rete, Blockly, TypeScript or the Designer. These pages cover starting a script with or without a project, finding it again, how it is saved as you work and how its history and cloud backups bring back an earlier version, exporting and importing files, previews you can share, embedding a preview in your own website, and searching other people's public scripts.
